اعترضا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَضَا (iʕtaraḍā) /iʕ.ta.ra.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اُعْتُرِضَا (uʕturiḍā) /uʕ.tu.ri.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اِعْتَرِضَا (iʕtariḍā) /iʕ.ta.ri.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
